title: Peculiar Flag
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You alphabetize your cereal by shape
I name the pigeons waiting by the gate
You wear one mitten, though the day is warm
I keep a pocket full of ticket stubs and thorns

They say, "Be normal," like it's something you can buy
Like there's a correct way to misplace your mind
But every crooked detail that you tried to hide
Is a door you get to open from the inside

[Pre-Chorus]
So bring your bent ideas
Your laugh at the wrong time
The things you keep collecting
That don't fit in a line

[Chorus]
Come as strange as you are
Come too loud, come offbeat
Bring the whole odd parade
With your mismatched feet
We were never made
To be copies in a row
Let your peculiar flag fly
Let the good weird show

[Verse 2]
You talk to houseplants, give them little names
I save the buttons from my coats like tiny brains
You take the long way just to count the doors
I make up secret histories for grocery-store floors

No need to sand the corners from your grin
No need to file your favorite edges in
The room gets bigger every time we let
One more unpolished piece of us in yet

[Pre-Chorus]
So bring your bent ideas
Your laugh at the wrong time
The things you keep collecting
That don't fit in a line

[Chorus]
Come as strange as you are
Come too loud, come offbeat
Bring the whole odd parade
With your mismatched feet
We were never made
To be copies in a row
Let your peculiar flag fly
Let the good weird show

[Bridge]
I spent years trying to pass for plain
Pressed my wild little thoughts into a frame
Then you showed up with a pocket-sized spoon
And said, "I carry it in case the soup comes soon"
And I laughed till the old shame let go
There was room at the table; I finally know

[Final Chorus]
Come as strange as you are
Come too loud, come offbeat
Bring the whole odd parade
With your mismatched feet
We were never made
To be copies in a row
Let your peculiar flag fly
Let the good weird show

Come as strange as you are
Let the bright cracks show
We belong in the room
We belong as we grow
[Outro]
Your crooked grin, my pocket of stones
Nobody here has to fit the mold
Come as strange as you are
Come as strange as you are

title: A Glorious Mess
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You alphabetize your spoons
I name the pigeons on the roof
You wear your coat inside out
Like you’ve got nothing left to prove

I keep a tiny plastic horse
Beside the bills I never sort
We trade our oddities like cards
And laugh till every rule falls short

[Pre-Chorus]
You thought you had to sand it down
Fold your elbows, lower sound
But every strange and crooked part
Is where the daylight gets its start

[Chorus]
Be weird, be loud, take up the room
Wear your mismatched socks to the moon
You don’t owe anybody neat
You’re not a flaw they get to keep
Be weird, be wild, let your colors spill
The world can learn to love you still
All of us, a glorious mess—
Come as you are, and nothing less

[Verse 2]
You talk to plants in different voices
I make up names for passing trains
Your lunch is pickles, cake, and noodles
My lucky hat has coffee stains

They made a box and drew a line
Then told us all to fit inside
But you were never built to fold
And I was never made to hide

[Pre-Chorus]
You thought you had to sand it down
Fold your elbows, lower sound
But every strange and crooked part
Is where the daylight gets its start

[Chorus]
Be weird, be loud, take up the room
Wear your mismatched socks to the moon
You don’t owe anybody neat
You’re not a flaw they get to keep
Be weird, be wild, let your colors spill
The world can learn to love you still
All of us, a glorious mess—
Come as you are, and nothing less

[Bridge]
To the kid who eats lunch in the stairwell
To the grown-up who still keeps that toy
To the one who rehearses every hello
You are not too much, you are not a decoy

Let the strange little habits stay
Let the unapproved laugh break free
We were never meant to match—
We’re the proof of what a life can be

[Final Chorus]
Be weird, be loud, take up the room
Wear your mismatched socks to the moon
You don’t owe anybody neat
You’re not a flaw they get to keep
Be weird, be wild, let your colors spill
The world can learn to love you still
All of us, a glorious mess—
Come as you are, and nothing less

[Outro]
Come as you are
Nothing less
A glorious mess
Nothing less

title: Your Seams Showing Through
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You fold your sleeves to hide the paint
You count your words before they land
You laugh too loud at your own joke
Then tuck your grin back in your hand

You keep a list of little rules
For how a person ought to be
But every box you squeeze into
Was drawn too small for you and me

[Pre-Chorus]
So let the crooked picture hang
Let the odd note ring out long
All those parts you tried to change
Were trying to make you whole

[Chorus]
Be strange, be loud, be wonderfully wrong
Take up the room you’ve been shrinking in for so long
Your bent little compass still points you somewhere true
The world gets less alive when it edits out you
So come as you are, with your seams showing through
Be strange, be loud—there’s a place here for you

[Verse 2]
You name your plants like old friends
Wear that coat in July heat
Turn every grocery run into
A private parade down the street

Your hands keep moving when you talk
Your mind takes side roads just for fun
You thought that made you hard to love
It’s how you make the colors come

[Pre-Chorus]
Let the crooked picture hang
Let the odd note ring out long
All those parts you tried to change
Were trying to make you whole

[Chorus]
Be strange, be loud, be wonderfully wrong
Take up the room you’ve been shrinking in for so long
Your bent little compass still points you somewhere true
The world gets less alive when it edits out you
So come as you are, with your seams showing through
Be strange, be loud—there’s a place here for you

[Bridge]
I kept my hands behind my back
I kept my questions in a drawer
Then you showed up wearing stars
On a jacket made for four
And I saw my own odd shape
In the way you took your space
No more sanding down the edges
No more asking to be plain

[Final Chorus]
Be strange, be loud, be wonderfully wrong
Take up the room you’ve been shrinking in for so long
Your bent little compass still points you somewhere true
The world gets less alive when it edits out you
Come as you are, let the whole room see through

Be strange, be loud—there’s a place here for you
A place here for you

[Outro]
Your seams showing through
There’s a place here for you

title: Gloriously You
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You sort your buttons by the shade of blue

You count the tiles before you sleep
You keep a marble in your coat

[Pre-Chorus]
They said, "Be normal," like it's easy

[Final Chorus]

Wear the paper crown and the mismatched shoes
If your heart takes turns that nobody knew
Take them, take them—there's room for you

Be strange, be bright, let your oddness through
The things they call too much are your best truths
Come on, let the whole room loosen its screws
We were never made to fit one groove

[Outro]
One groove? No way
One shape? Not you
Be strange, be loud
Be gloriously you

lyrics:

title: One Open Hand

title: Time Begins When I Let Go

title: Lifting of the Chain
lyrics:

title: Setting Down the Stone

title: Learning How to Stay
lyrics:

title: Growing Where I Am

title: Someone Worth Becoming

There is breath beneath the pressure
There is time I haven't used

I don't need to solve the silence

title: Beneath the Borrowed Skin
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I count the rooms I never entered

Call my name, call my name
Let the old disguise fall down
Call my name, call my name
I am still becoming now

[Verse 2]

[Pre-Chorus]
If I’m more, why do I hide?
If I’m free, what holds the tide?

[Chorus]
Who am I when no one needs a reason?
Who am I beneath the borrowed skin?
I keep climbing through the changing seasons
Just to find the door was locked within
Call my name, call my name
Let the old disguise fall down
Call my name, call my name
I am still becoming now

[Bridge]
Lower the room, let the pulse remain
Put every title down like a chain
No grand reveal, no perfect proof
Just my two feet on an unfinished truth

[Final Chorus]
Who am I when no one needs a reason?
Who am I beneath the borrowed skin?
I stop running from the changing seasons
Turn the handle, let the daylight in
Call my name, call my name
Let the old disguise fall down
Call my name, call my name
I am still becoming now
I am still becoming now

[Outro]

One open door

title: Life Feels Like Home
lyrics:

There’s a small red mark on my right-hand thumb

[Pre-Chorus]

[Chorus]
I’m not a hunger wearing a face

[Final Chorus]
I’m not a hunger wearing a face

I make a life that feels like home

I’ll answer clear, I won’t bow down

Now I let the whole self in

title: Make Room for What Is True
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I wore every answer like a borrowed coat

title: I Begin
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I wore five faces to the morning train

One chased the heat of a stranger's skin
One counted duties I couldn't miss
One drew a map to a higher room
While I kept shrinking to fit the suit

[Pre-Chorus]

[Chorus]
I am not the war between them
Not the crown, not the chain
I can gather every splinter

Let the wanting kneel beside me
Let the guilty heart release
All the parts I kept dividing

[Verse 2]
There was a photograph under the bed
A child with a bruise-colored sky overhead
He had no empire, no alibi
Just a small bright pulse he refused to hide

[Pre-Chorus]
For the hand that reaches, the hand that gives
The hand that builds and the hand that lives
No appetite has to rule the house
No buried voice has to drown me out

[Chorus]
I am not the war between them
Not the crown, not the chain
I can gather every splinter
And still answer to my name
Let the wanting kneel beside me
Let the guilty heart release
All the parts I kept dividing
Can come home and make me whole

[Bridge]
Ambition, sit down at the table
Lust, tell the truth and stay
Duty, loosen your collar
Pride, put the knife away
I will not crown one hunger
I will not exile the rest
I am the room they share together
I am the breath in my chest

[Final Chorus]
I am not the war between them
I am wider than the flame
I can carry every fracture

Let the wanting move beside me
Let the old masks fall below
All the parts I kept dividing
Have come home, and now I know

[Outro]
No perfect angel, no enemy
Just every unfinished part of me
Hand in hand beneath one skin

title: Give Your Love Back Better
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You bring me coffee before the morning
Leave your coat on the kitchen chair
You learn the names of the things I’m carrying
And make room for them there

I used to call every locked door destiny
Wear out my shoes on the floor
Now I can see what was standing beside me
I don’t have to beg anymore

[Pre-Chorus]
If your hands reach out
I won’t make you prove
I’ll stop feeding empty rooms
And turn my face to you

[Chorus]
I’ll give your love back better
Not measured, not delayed
I’ll meet you in the middle
With both feet on the pavement

I’m done chasing a promise
That never learned my name
What you give me, I’ll return it better
What won’t come back, I won’t chase

[Verse 2]
You send a message just to say you miss me
Not because you need a favor
You hear the joke beneath my silence
And stay when I lose the flavor

I used to polish every almost
Call the distance something deep
Now I leave the chair for someone willing
To sit beside me while I sleep

[Pre-Chorus]
If your heart opens wide
I won’t stand outside
I’ll bring the parts I kept in boxes

[Chorus]
I’ll give your love back better
Not measured, not delayed
I’ll meet you in the middle
With both feet on the pavement

I’m done chasing a promise

What you give me, I’ll return it better
What won’t come back, I won’t chase

[Bridge]

[Final Lift]

title: Beautifully Furnished Cage
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I watched the kettle blink
Then watched it blink again
The toast came up too fast
So I made it happen then

I opened every app
Forgot what I was for
I walked from room to room

[Pre-Chorus]
Give me a problem
Give me a sign
Give me a reason

[Chorus]
I am bored, bored, bored

I am bored, bored, bored

I spin the little wheel
I refresh the same page
I am bored, bored, bored
In a beautifully furnished cage

[Verse 2]
The laundry waits in piles
The clock performs its trick
A minute takes forever
Then an hour vanishes quick

I text you, "What is up?"

[Pre-Chorus]
Give me a danger

Something with air

[Chorus]
I am bored, bored, bored
With the shape of my day
I am bored, bored, bored

I spin the little wheel
I refresh the same page
I am bored, bored, bored

[Final Chorus]
I am bored, bored, bored

[Outro]

title: Chess Alone
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
My inbox opens before the blinds
A thousand small fires, all marked urgent
I trade my breakfast for deadline lines
And wear the same shirt on purpose

The group chat moved without my name
Their weekend plans became old news
I set the board beside the frame
And wait for someone I can’t lose

[Pre-Chorus]
White square, black square, quiet room
The clock keeps cutting through
I know each move before it lands
Still I don’t know what to do

[Chorus]
I play chess alone
Two colors, one phone
I check my own king
Then answer my own call

I work till the office hums
And the last train has gone
If friendship needs a little time
I never seem to have one

[Verse 2]
A rook goes straight like my career
A bishop bends around the truth
The knight arrives from nowhere near

I leave one chair across the table

[Pre-Chorus]
White square, black square, coffee stain

[Chorus]
I play chess alone
Two colors, one phone
I check my own king

I work till the office hums

I play chess alone
Two colors, one phone
No crowd, no throne

title: I'm Letting It In
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I signed my name in rooms that shook
Turned rough ideas into something they could book
Kept every receipt in a drawer by the bed
Still hear a jury forming in my head

I crossed the miles they said were too far
Put my fingerprints on every open door
They raised their glasses, called me by my name
I nodded like approval was a claim

[Pre-Chorus]
You said, “We saw what you became”
You said, “You earned your place”

[Chorus]
How many times do you have to tell me

I built the bridge, I crossed the distance
I did the work, I passed the test
You gave me every green light shining
I still go looking for the red
How many times do you have to tell me
I’m not on trial again?

[Verse 2]
There’s a photograph above the kitchen sink
A younger me who barely dared to think
He’d trade his sleep for one approving nod
Now he has a shelf full of proof and still feels caught

The names I feared are names I know

[Pre-Chorus]

[Chorus]
How many times do you have to tell me

I built the bridge, I crossed the distance

[Final Chorus]

I built the bridge, I crossed the distance
I did the work, I did it good
Your green lights fill the whole horizon

[Outro]
I’m letting it in
I’m letting it in
The door was never locked

title: Let the Record Stand
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I cleared every hurdle they placed in the lane

[Chorus]
I have done enough, let the record stand
I have built these bridges with my own two hands
If you need one more reason, take this heart and see
I am not a question waiting for your belief

I have done enough, I am here, I remain
Not a trial to endure, not a debt to explain
Let the old doubt gather where the old doubts belong
I was proving my life; now I’m proving them wrong

[Bridge]
Keep your ledger, keep your careful inspection
Keep the raised eyebrow dressed as protection
I know every failure that carried me through
I know every hard-won thing I had to undo

No, I won’t make a shrine of the things I survived
No, I won’t beg a room to admit I’m alive
There is nothing left here that I owe to their eyes

[Final Chorus]
I have done enough, let the record stand
I have built these bridges with my own two hands
If you need one more reason, take this heart and see
I am not a question waiting for your belief

I have done enough, I am here, I remain
Not a trial to endure, not a debt to explain
Let the old doubt gather where the old doubts belong
I was proving my life; now I’m proving them wrong

[Outro]
Let the record stand
Let the whole room know

title: I Have Done Enough
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I brought home the medals

I have done enough
I have done enough

I carried it up

I have done enough
No more borrowed praise
I won't keep auditioning
For a place I already made

title: Give Without Becoming God
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I leave a chair at every table
Call it care, call it grace
I learn the shape of every sorrow
Then wear it on my face

A message waits, I answer quickly
A promise blooms, I take the blame

Is this mercy or a mirror?

[Verse 2]
I know the birthdays, know the breakups

[Pre-Chorus]

[Chorus]
Do I love you, or love being needed?
Do I open the door, or need it left ajar?

[Bridge]
Maybe kindness has a boundary

[Final Chorus]

I can open the door, then let you choose
If I carry only what is mine

I keep pouring, but the cup is honest
No applause, no debt, no claim
If your freedom is the answer

[Outro]

title: Fingerprints on the Door
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I learned every doorway

I gave away my mornings

[Pre-Chorus]

[Verse 2]

Who could love me now

[Final Chorus]

You could love me now
You could love me now

[Outro]
I am not the sum of who I saved

title: Keep a Little Love for Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I learned every birthday, every favorite song

[Verse 2]

[Pre-Chorus]

[Chorus]
I gave too much love away
Till my hands forgot their shape
Now you reach for me and I
Feel like something counterfeit
I poured myself through every door
Left no river at the source
If you call me worthy, I
Won't know what you mean by it

[Bridge]
Maybe love is not a debt

If I save one piece tonight
It can teach the rest to fight

[Instrumental]

[Final Chorus]
I gave too much love away
But my hands can learn their shape
When you reach for me, I might
Let the door stay open a bit
I poured myself through every door
Now I know what roots are for
If you call me worthy, I
May believe you when you say it

[Outro]
I am more than what I gave
More than every life I saved
Keep a little love for me
Keep a little love for me

title: What's Left of Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I learned your birthdays by the weather
Kept spare keys beneath the mat
I answered every late confession
Like my own heart wasn't cracked

I wore the coat you left behind
Sent groceries across town
I gave a little piece of myself
Whenever you were breaking down

[Pre-Chorus]
Now every room feels borrowed
Every promise sounds rehearsed
I poured myself into your hands
And somehow I came out worse

[Chorus]
Who would love what's left of me?
I gave it out so faithfully
To every lonely, burning soul
Till mine forgot the shape of whole

Who would stay and let me be?
Not the version built to please
I spent my love on everyone
Now I don't know where mine has gone

[Verse 2]
I know the names of all your ghosts
The coffee order, train, and street
I held the door through every storm
Then watched you leave on steady feet

You called me when the night got heavy
I made the darkness small
But when the silence found my number
There was no one left to call

[Pre-Chorus]
I made a home in open hands
And called the giving proof of worth
But love is not a leaking roof
You stand beneath until you hurt

[Chorus]
Who would love what's left of me?
I gave it out so faithfully
To every lonely, burning soul
Till mine forgot the shape of whole

Who would stay and let me be?
Not the version built to please
I spent my love on everyone
Now I don't know where mine has gone

[Bridge]
Maybe I was never empty
Maybe I was overrun
Every door I held wide open
Let somebody else come in

I can gather what remains here
Name it gently, piece by piece
If I stop auditioning for love
Perhaps it can come find me

[Final Chorus]
Who would love what's left of me?
I am more than history
All the hands I tried to save
Do not decide the life I make

Who would stay and let me be?
I can learn to keep some peace
I spent my love on everyone
Now I am becoming someone

[Outro]
I am becoming someone
I am becoming someone
With a heart I won't give away
Just to make another stay

title: Better Parts
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept a chair for every name
Made room until the walls gave way
I learned the shape of every hurt
Then wore their weather like a shirt

I answered calls beneath the rain
Held every promise through the strain
They took the warmth I couldn't spare
And left me measuring empty chairs

[Pre-Chorus]
Now every hand that reaches out
Feels like a debt I can't work out
I call it kindness, call it proof
Then wonder why I have no room

[Chorus]
I gave away my better parts
To too many hands, too many hearts
Now when you tell me I am loved
I look for what you want from us

I poured myself through every door
Till I was less than I was before
If love can leave a person bare
Maybe I'm not worthy anywhere

[Verse 2]
I know their birthdays, know their scars
Which late-night diner, which parked car
I kept the details, kept the trust
While mine grew thin and turned to dust

A borrowed coat, a midnight ride
A thousand ways I stepped aside
They called me strong, I let it land
Like strength was something I had planned

[Pre-Chorus]
Now kindness sounds like coming clean
A room with nothing in between
I can't tell giving from goodbye
Or being needed from being mine

[Chorus]
I gave away my better parts
To too many hands, too many hearts
Now when you tell me I am loved
I look for what you want from us

I poured myself through every door
Till I was less than I was before
If love can leave a person bare
Maybe I'm not worthy anywhere

[Bridge]
But you don't have to pay my past
Or prove your staying will outlast
The ones who took and disappeared
The years I spent becoming useful here

Leave one small light beside the sink
Give me the time to stop and think
If you can hold me without a claim
I might relearn my own name

[Breakdown]
Not a vessel
Not a remedy
Not the hands that rescue everybody
Not a vacancy
Not a borrowed flame
I am more than what I gave away

[Final Chorus]
I gave away my better parts
To too many hands, too many hearts
But you don't ask me to perform
You meet me where the walls are torn

I poured myself through every door
Now I can choose what love is for
The worth I thought I had to earn
Was waiting underneath the burn

[Outro]
If I have less, let less be true
A little left to give to you
Not as a debt, not as a plea
Just something living, left in me

title: Unworthy of Love
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I learned your birthdays, your coffee, your scars
Kept spare apologies folded in jars
I answered every call before it could ring
Made room at the table, gave away everything

I wore every silence like somebody’s coat
Held all your weather inside my throat
Now I count the names carved under my skin
And wonder what kind of love lets me in

[Pre-Chorus]
I gave until giving became my disguise
A generous hand with a locked pair of eyes
If you saw what is left when the crowd disappears
Would you call it a heart, or a handful of years?

[Chorus]
I feel unworthy of love
I spent mine like water on everyone
I poured out the best of me
Now there’s barely a drop when you reach for me
I feel unworthy of love
Too many doors, too many vows undone
If you hold me, hold me slow
I’m learning I’m more than the places I go

[Verse 2]
I knew how to listen, I knew how to stay
I made my own hunger wait another day
Your emergencies slept in the room by my bed
While my little disasters went quietly unfed

I called it devotion, I called it repair
But love without limits can vanish in air
Now kindness feels guilty, and rest feels like theft
I’m afraid that a heart can be emptied of depth

[Pre-Chorus]
I gave until giving became my disguise
A generous hand with a locked pair of eyes
If you saw what is left when the crowd disappears
Would you call it a heart, or a handful of years?

[Chorus]
I feel unworthy of love
I spent mine like water on everyone
I poured out the best of me
Now there’s barely a drop when you reach for me
I feel unworthy of love
Too many doors, too many vows undone
If you hold me, hold me slow
I’m learning I’m more than the places I go

[Bridge]
Don’t praise the wound for surviving the knife
Don’t make my exhaustion proof I was right
I can draw one clean line and still care what you need
I can leave some light in the house for me

Maybe love isn’t measured by how much I lose
Maybe a yes can be honest, a no can be true
I’m not the sum of the hands I have fed
There is still a pulse here, still blood in my head

[Final Chorus]
I feel unworthy of love
But I’m done spending myself to become someone’s sun
I can keep a little warmth for me
Let it gather slowly, let it teach me to breathe
I feel unworthy of love
Still I’m standing where the old fear was
If you hold me, hold me slow
I’m more than the places I go

[Outro]
I gave too much, but I’m not gone
A heart can close and still beat on
I gave too much, but I’m not gone
I can come back, I can come back

title: Will You Remember Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I signed my name on the back of a photograph
Tucked it beneath the receipts in your kitchen drawer
The years kept moving like traffic past the glass
And I kept asking what any of it mattered for

I learned the shape of a crowded room
How to disappear while standing in view
Every joke I made became afternoon
Every promise faded before it came true

[Pre-Chorus]
If I stop calling, will the silence close?
If I leave this town, what remains to show?

[Chorus]
Will you remember me when the details go?
When my face turns faint in the afterglow?
I don't need a statue, I don't need a name
Just one small proof I was here when I came
Will you remember me, remember me?
Or will I vanish clean?

[Verse 2]
I found an old receipt with a date from July
For a train we missed and a lunch we never ate
Your handwriting leaned like it wanted to fly
Mine looked small at the bottom, asking you to wait

Now the people I loved have new locks on their doors
New routines, new friends, new stories to tell
I keep rehearsing the sound of before
Like a match in a room where the oxygen fell

[Pre-Chorus]
If the years erase the roads we chose
Does a buried word still know who it knows?

[Chorus]
Will you remember me when the details go?
When my face turns faint in the afterglow?
I don't need a statue, I don't need a name
Just one small proof I was here when I came
Will you remember me, remember me?
Or will I vanish clean?

[Breakdown]
Say it once—my name
Say it twice—don't let it change
If the room goes quiet, if the calendar bends
Tell me I was more than a temporary friend

[Bridge]
Maybe being remembered isn't carved in stone
Maybe it's the way you turn when you hear my old joke
Maybe it's a scar in the grain of your home
A borrowed phrase that survives in your throat

[Instrumental]

[Final Chorus]
Will you remember me when the details go?
When my face turns faint in the afterglow?
I don't need a statue, I don't need a name
Just one small proof I was here when I came
Will you remember me, remember me?
Hold the line, don't let me leave
Will you remember me, remember me?
Even if the world forgets me

[Outro]
Keep one photograph facedown in a drawer
Keep one unfinished sentence by the door
If you say my name when nobody knows
I'll be there in the answer, wherever it goes

title: How Much Do I Need
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
How many names must I carve in stone
Before the years leave me alone?
How many rooms, how many hands
Before I outlive what I planned?

I count the faces in the frame
Each little victory feeds the flame
The calendar tears, the mirrors change
I keep building against the age

[Pre-Chorus]
If I conquer every summit
If I make the whole world know
Will the silence call me lasting
When the last bright banners fold?

[Chorus]
How much do I need to become immortal?
How far can I run from the closing door?
If the whole world carries my name tomorrow
Will I still be here when I need it more?
How much do I need, how much do I need?
Or is forever just a hunger wearing victory?

[Verse 2]
I put my fingerprints in books
I teach the young to chase my looks
I leave a message in the brick
A louder monument, a cleaner myth

But every statue gathers rain
Every headline fades beneath the next campaign
I hear my pulse inside the crowd
It sounds so small when they get loud

[Pre-Chorus]
If I turn my grief to marble
If I make my failure gold
Will a stranger speak me gently
When the story gets retold?

[Chorus]
How much do I need to become immortal?
How far can I run from the closing door?
If the whole world carries my name tomorrow
Will I still be here when I need it more?
How much do I need, how much do I need?
Or is forever just a hunger wearing victory?

[Bridge]
Maybe immortality is one kid keeping your advice
One scar that taught somebody else to choose a different life
Maybe it is not the tower, not the anthem, not the throne
Maybe I survive in every heart I helped feel less alone

[Breakdown]
No more counting
No more proof
No more bargaining with the truth
If I vanish, let the good remain
Not my face, but what I changed

[Final Chorus]
How much did I need to become immortal?
I spent my life running toward a door
Now the hands I held are carrying forward
And I don't have to be afraid anymore
How much did I need? I needed one thing:
A life that leaves a little more mercy than it brings

[Outro]
Let the years erase the name
Let the people keep the flame
If I am gone when morning comes
Let what I gave keep moving on

title: Choose the Door
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I wake beneath a borrowed answer
Folded neatly by the bed
Every door says keep surrendering
Every pulse says move ahead

I trace the cracks across the ceiling
Count the reasons to remain
Hope arrives without permission
Submission wears my name

[Pre-Chorus]
If I kneel, will the ground forgive me?
If I stand, will I disappear?
There’s a voice that calls it safety
There’s a louder one I hear

[Chorus]
I am not the hand that pulls me under
I am not the cage I learned to love
Hope is a match inside the thunder
Submission says I’ve had enough
I bend, I break, I come back furious
With both feet shaking on the floor
If I have to choose between the silence
And the wound, I’ll choose the door

[Verse 2]
I wore obedience like a jacket
Heavy seams against my throat
Every promise made me smaller
Every failure kept me close

Then a red light crossed the hallway
Then my heartbeat missed the count
I could feel the locked-up future
Pushing from the inside out

[Pre-Chorus]
If I stay, will the fear grow gentle?
If I leave, what will I lose?
There’s a hand that holds my shoulder
There’s a fist I have to choose

[Chorus]
I am not the hand that pulls me under
I am not the cage I learned to love
Hope is a match inside the thunder
Submission says I’ve had enough
I bend, I break, I come back furious
With both feet shaking on the floor
If I have to choose between the silence
And the wound, I’ll choose the door

[Bridge]
Let the room collapse around me
Let the old commands turn dust
I can fear the open distance
I can move because I must

[Breakdown]
No more waiting for permission
No more blessing from the chain
I can carry every consequence
I can call it by its name

[Instrumental]

[Final Chorus]
I am not the hand that pulls me under
I am not the cage I learned to love
Hope is a match inside the thunder
Submission says I’ve had enough
I bend, I break, I come back furious
With both feet shaking on the floor
If I have to choose between the silence
And the wound, I’ll choose the door

[Outro]
The door is open
The fear is mine
I step through trembling
And call it life

title: Man Behind the Glass
lyrics:
[Intro: clean delay guitar, distant feedback, low synth drone, heartbeat kick]

[whispered vocal, close-mic]
There’s a face behind the viewport…

[Verse 1: clean arpeggiated guitar, melodic bass, restrained tom groove]

There’s a face behind the viewport
wearing mine but smiling wrong
It says, “Let them orbit around you,
you were born to be their sun”

[second guitar enters with high dissonant harmonics]

Down the corridor the red lights
paint the walls like open veins
Every voice becomes a signal
calling out my name again

[Pre-Chorus: bass becomes syncopated, drums open up, distorted guitar swells]

I hear them breathing
behind every door
Do I want to save them
or be needed more?

[drums stop]

[half-whisper]
Tell me what I’m doing this for.

[Chorus: full distorted guitars, octave lead melody, huge live drums, layered high vocals]

Kill the man behind the glass
before he learns to wear my skin
He feeds on every hand I hold
and calls the hunger “giving”

I want to love without possession
I want to bleed without applause
But there’s a creature in my chest
that turns compassion into claws

[Post-Chorus: rapid angular guitar riff, 7/8 bar inserted into 4/4]

[Verse 2: palm-muted guitar, aggressive bass counterline, nervous hi-hat]

We found bodies in the engine room
with halos wired to their heads
Every kindness copied backward
every prayer returning dead

[instrumentation suddenly drops to bass + vocal]

The thing inside the circuitry
speaks softly through the walls:

[distorted backing vocal]
“Make them grateful…”

[full band crash]

“Make them need you,
then you’ll never feel small”

[Pre-Chorus: rising guitar harmonics, snare rolls, stacked vocal doubles]

I seal the chamber
I cut the feed
But is this mercy
or another need?

[Chorus: wider harmonies, added counter-melody guitar]

Kill the man behind the glass
before he learns to wear my skin
He feeds on every hand I hold
and calls the hunger “giving”

I want to love without possession
I want to bleed without applause
But there’s a creature in my chest
that turns compassion into claws

[Instrumental Shift: drums enter double-time, bass runs underneath tapping guitar figure]

[8 bars: technical prog riff alternating 5/4 and 6/8]

[sudden cut to silence]

[Bridge: lone piano, clean guitar volume swells, distant choir]

If I save the ship
and carve my name into the hull
was anybody rescued
or did I just become the cult?

[low synth pulse enters]

If I give my life
and make them watch me disappear
is that sacrifice
or vanity dressed up as fear?

[Build: toms enter slowly, bass climbs chromatically]

[distorted whispers panned left and right]
They love you.
They need you.
They owe you.

[drums accelerate]

They love you.
They need you.
They owe you.

[Breakdown: crushing half-time riff, detuned guitars]

[shouted]
NO!

[guitars drop out]

No crown.
No witness.
No debt.
No god.

[Final Chorus: soaring lead guitar, full choir harmonies, double-kick under melodic chorus]

Break the glass and flood the chamber
let the vacuum take the crown
If love is real, it needs no witness
no one has to write it down

I’ll keep the monster in the mirror
I’ll know exactly what it was
And choose the hand that asks for nothing

[band cuts]

[solo vocal]
over compassion made of claws.

[Outro: clean guitar reprises intro motif, bass plays descending melody, tape-warp synth]

[whispered]
If no one knows…

[long pause]

…would I still do it?

title: The Good Parts of You
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep a file of the days I survived
Receipts in a drawer, old names on the side
A bus ticket folded from late October
Proof I was there before doubt took over

I read every flaw like a verdict in red
Turn a tired little thought into something I said
But somewhere beneath all the noise in my head
There’s a kid who kept going when hope should have fled

[Pre-Chorus]
When the mirror starts building a case
When I measure my worth by the lines on my face
I’ll reach for the moments I nearly erase
And let them remind me I’m more than this day

[Chorus]
Remember the good parts of you
The hands that held on, the hard things you moved through
When judgment comes sharpened and cold
Keep every small victory safe in your soul
Remember the good parts, remember they’re true
The world may be ruthless, don’t turn it on you
If all you can do is make it to dawn
That is a life with the lights still on

[Verse 2]
There’s a voice note recorded beside the kitchen sink
You laugh at the ending before you can think
A friend says my name like it still means something
And for one quiet second, the room stops running

I have been cruel to the person I am
For every missed chance, every unfinished plan
But the scars on my knuckles, the dirt on my hands
Are not proof I failed—they’re the shape of my stand

[Pre-Chorus]
When the mirror starts building a case
When every mistake gets a permanent place
I’ll gather the evidence fear threw away
The love I gave freely, the times that I stayed

[Chorus]
Remember the good parts of you
The hands that held on, the hard things you moved through
When judgment comes sharpened and cold
Keep every small victory safe in your soul
Remember the good parts, remember they’re true
The world may be ruthless, don’t turn it on you
If all you can do is make it to dawn
That is a life with the lights still on

[Bridge]
I am not only the worst thing I’ve done
Not every closed door means I came undone
There’s a pulse in the wreckage, a warmth in the bruise
A thousand small reasons I still get to choose

[Breakdown]
Say it plain
I was here
I was kind
I was scared
Still I stayed
Still I tried
That is mine
That is mine

[Instrumental]

[Final Chorus]
Remember the good parts of you
The hands that held on, the hard things you moved through
When judgment comes sharpened and cold
Keep every small victory safe in your soul
Remember the good parts, remember they’re true
Even your tired heart is carrying you
If all you can do is make it to dawn
That is a life with the lights still on

[Outro]
Keep the note in the drawer
Keep the laugh on the phone
When you can’t see the good in yourself
Borrow mine till you know

title: Let It Take Its Time
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I’m leaning by the corner store
With one hand wrapped around my coat
A paper cup goes cold beside me
The afternoon is moving slow

No need to solve the week right now
No need to make the minutes pay
A car can turn up when it turns up
I get this quiet either way

[Pre-Chorus]
The bench is warm from someone else
A sparrow picks at crumbs below
I watch the clouds rearrange themselves
And let the waiting be enough

[Chorus]
Let it take its time, let it take its time
I’ve got nowhere I have to be tonight
Let the engine hum somewhere down the line
For a little while, this stillness is mine

[Verse 2]
A woman laughs into her phone
A dog pulls hard against its lead
The traffic folds around the block
Like water finding where to be

I used to fill the empty space
With lists of things I’d failed to do
But now I hear the leaves turn over
And feel the day come back in view

[Pre-Chorus]
The sign keeps blinking open, closed
The light changes twice, then changes slow
I breathe beneath the ordinary
And let the waiting be enough

[Chorus]
Let it take its time, let it take its time
I’ve got nowhere I have to be tonight
Let the engine hum somewhere down the line
For a little while, this stillness is mine

[Bridge]
If the ride is late, I’ll stay here
If the ride is late, I’ll stay here
There’s a blue cup rolling in the gutter
There’s a gold thread caught in the weather
And I don’t have to chase it
I don’t have to name it
I can meet the world exactly where it is

[Final Chorus]
Let it take its time, let it take its time
Now the whole wide evening is opening its eyes
Let the engine hum somewhere down the line
I was looking for a way out, found a little peace of mind

Let it take its time, let it take its time
When the headlights turn, I’ll wave and climb inside
But until that moment, this stillness is mine
A small and steady mercy at the edge of the night

[Outro]
Let it take its time
I’ll be right here
Let it take its time
The road can wait a little longer

title: Cover Wings
lyrics:
[Verse 1]

We ran through the static
With fire in our lungs
Chasing every signal
Before the night was done

The city fell beneath us
The noise became a spark
We learned to trust the falling
Before we feared the dark

[Pre-Chorus]

No map, no warning
No perfect way through
Just gravity breaking
The moment I found you

[Chrorus]
In the sky cover wings
We dive align wild

[Verse 2]

The horizon keeps moving
Like something we can chase
Every turn becoming
Another unknown place

We carry all our failures
Like feathers in the storm
Nothing ever promised
That flying would feel warm

[Pre-Chorus]

No cage, no ceiling
No reason to stay still
We bend with the current
Then rise against our will

[Chrorus]
In the sky cover wings
We dive align wild

[Bridge]

If we fall, let us fall forward
If we break, let the light come through
Every scar becomes a compass
Every wrong turn something new

[Build]

Higher
Stranger
Faster
Free

No one gets to tell us
What the shape of flight should be

[Final Chrorus]
In the sky cover wings
We dive align wild

In the sky cover wings
We dive align wild

[Outro]

Cover wings
Dive wild
Lose the ground
Find the sky

title: It’s the Work I return to
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept the medals in a kitchen drawer
Beside the batteries and takeout menus
Their little dates meant less each year
While dust made a home around the edges

I know the rooms where I was praised
The exact applause, the practiced grin
But every summit had a closing time
And every photograph grew thin

[Pre-Chorus]
I thought the point was getting there
I thought the proof would make me whole
Now I can hear the question underneath:
What do I carry when they let me go?

[Chorus]
If the best is behind me
Let it stay where it belongs
I am more than the height I reached
More than the place I came from
I can build with smaller pieces
I can choose what still feels true
Purpose isn't waiting at the finish
It's the work I return to

[Verse 2]
My old ambition wears a borrowed coat
It doesn't fit the shoulders that I have
I used to measure mornings by the calls
Now I make coffee for my neighbor's dad

A younger version of me wants a crown
He keeps a tally underneath his tongue
I tell him, you were brave to want the world
But wanting isn't all that makes you young

[Pre-Chorus]
The room is quiet after everyone leaves
No headline tells me what to do
So I put my hands back on the ordinary
And let the ordinary pull me through

[Chorus]
If the best is behind me
Let it stay where it belongs
I am more than the height I reached
More than the place I came from
I can build with smaller pieces
I can choose what still feels true
Purpose isn't waiting at the finish
It's the work I return to

[Bridge]
There is a kid downstairs learning three chords
Missing every change but starting again
I sit beside him, count the bars aloud
And feel a door unlatch inside my chest

Maybe a life is not a mountain
Maybe it's a table passed around
A place to bring the strength you gathered
A reason to keep showing up now

[Final Chorus]
If the best is behind me
Then the road is still my own
I am more than the height I reached
I am not a monument
I can build with smaller pieces
I can choose what still feels true
Purpose isn't waiting at the finish
It's the work I return to

[Outro]
Put the medals in the kitchen drawer
Leave the morning open on the table
I don't need to be remembered yet
I only need to be useful while I'm able

title: Work in the Ordinary
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept the medals in a kitchen drawer
Under the takeout menus and spare keys
Some mornings I could name what they were for
Most days they felt like evidence against me

The room got quiet after every win
The applause became a coat I couldn't wear
I watched the younger version of my skin
Still waiting for somebody to get there

[Pre-Chorus]
I thought the best part had already happened
A finished book with nothing left to prove
But underneath the dust and old reactions
A stubborn little reason started moving

[Chorus]
If the peak is behind me, let it be
I am more than the highest thing they saw
There is work in the ordinary
There is a door I haven't opened yet at all
I was not built to live inside a headline
I was not born to guard a fading flame
If the best is gone, I'll make a new kind
With both hands shaking, I can start again

[Verse 2]
I found a notebook in the winter coat
Three crooked pages, coffee on the side
A half-made plan from someone I don't know
Who wrote, “Try the thing you keep denying”

So I walked down to the community hall
Where folding chairs were stacked against the wall
I taught a kid the chords I learned too late
And heard my old mistakes become their call

[Pre-Chorus]
No camera flash, no polished little ending
No promised proof that this would make me whole
Just one small life becoming less defended
Just one more person finding where to go

[Chorus]
If the peak is behind me, let it be
I am more than the highest thing they saw
There is work in the ordinary
There is a door I haven't opened yet at all
I was not built to live inside a headline
I was not born to guard a fading flame
If the best is gone, I'll make a new kind
With both hands shaking, I can start again

[Bridge]
I grieved the years I thought I had misplaced
The doors that closed, the names I couldn't keep
Then someone needed me in that small place
And pulled a living answer from the deep

Maybe purpose isn't thunder in the distance
Maybe it's showing up before you're ready
Maybe the hand you thought was empty
Is the hand that keeps somebody steady

[Final Chorus]
If the peak is behind me, let it be
I am more than the highest thing they saw
There is work in the ordinary
There is a door and I am walking through it now
I was not built to live inside a headline
I was not born to guard a fading flame
If the best is gone, I'll make a new kind
With both hands shaking, I can start again

[Outro]
The medals stay inside the kitchen drawer
The notebook opens on the table
I don't need to be who I was before
To be here, to be useful, to be able

title: Past the Peak
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Trophies collecting dust on a bedroom shelf
Framed clippings from a younger version of myself
Used to think the summit was the only place to breathe
Now I'm standing in the valley, learning how to leave
Unclench my fists from the ghost of what was
Looking for a spark that isn't just applause

[Pre-Chorus]
The noise has faded out, the stage lights all went dark
I spent so long chasing fire, I forgot the spark
Now the quiet opens up a simple open door

[Chorus]
It wasn't the peak, it was learning to climb
Finding a purpose outside of the shine
The greatest hits are behind in the rearview glass
Building something quiet that is meant to last
It's catharsis in the simple light
Finding a meaning in the quiet night

[Verse 2]
Clean hands working on a smaller wooden frame
No stadium shouting out a forgotten name
Just a quiet garden where the slow seeds grow
Planting for a season that I might not know
No clock to beat, no mountain left to scale
Just a quiet wind filling up a steady sail

[Pre-Chorus]
The noise has faded out, the stage lights all went dark
I spent so long chasing fire, I forgot the spark
Now the quiet opens up a simple open door

[Chorus]
It wasn't the peak, it was learning to climb
Finding a purpose outside of the shine
The greatest hits are behind in the rearview glass
Building something quiet that is meant to last
It's catharsis in the simple light
Finding a meaning in the quiet night

[Bridge]
Let the old gold rust
Let the old crowns fall into the dust
I don't need to be the hero of the story anymore
I just want to walk across an open floor
And feel the weight of living right now

[Outro]
Past the peak, into the green
Finding the purpose in between
The quiet night
The simple light
Past the peak, I breathe again
Starting where the old ends end

title: Medals in a Kitchen Drawer
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The medals sleep in a kitchen drawer
Their ribbons curled against the wood
I used to measure every open door
By how far I thought I should

The photographs have yellowed at the edge
The names beneath them fade
I keep expecting one more summit
To explain the choice I made

[Pre-Chorus]
If the best part already happened
Why am I still here?
With a pulse beneath the disappointment
And a road that disappears

[Chorus]
I am not finished
I am not the sum
Of the rooms I conquered
Or the race I never won
Let the old applause go quiet
Let the polished story bend
I can build a reason slowly
With my hands that still extend

[Verse 2]
There is a box beneath the bed
Full of badges, drafts, and dust
Every proof I saved for later
Could not teach me how to trust

So I walked past the familiar gate
Where everyone knew my name
Found a bench beside the river
And stayed until the water changed

[Pre-Chorus]
Maybe purpose is not thunder
Maybe it is small
A promise kept when no one sees it
A light left on in someone’s hall

[Chorus]
I am not finished
I am not the sum
Of the rooms I conquered
Or the race I never won
Let the old applause go quiet
Let the polished story bend
I can build a reason slowly
With my hands that still extend

[Bridge]
I have buried versions of me
That once believed they had to shine
Now I can carry what they started
Without mistaking it for mine

There is work beneath the wreckage
There is mercy in the wait
The future is not owed a masterpiece
It only asks that I participate

[Final Chorus]
I am not finished
I am not the sum
Of the doors behind me
Or the things I should have done
Let the old applause go quiet
Let the polished story bend
I can build a reason slowly
With my hands that still extend

I am not finished
Even here, even now
Not a final faded chapter
Not a ghost beneath the crowd
If my greatest days are behind me
Then I will turn and make amends
Find a purpose in the making
With these hands that still extend

[Outro]
The medals sleep in a kitchen drawer
I leave them where they are
There is a road beyond the wanting
And I can start without a map

title: Window Seat
lyrics:
[Intro]
Boarding starts at sunrise
One more hour, then I fly

[Verse 1]
Suitcase open by the bed
Blue shirt folded, passport checked
Phone is charging on the floor
I keep finding one thing more

The alarm is set for five
But my thoughts refuse to lie
Every little engine sound
Feels like wheels above the ground

[Pre-Chorus]
Close your eyes, the room turns wide
Runway dreams are on your side
Count the minutes, let them go
Morning knows the way to show

[Chorus]
Sleep tonight, sleep tonight
Morning’s waiting for the light
Hold me close, don’t let time run wild
I’ll be gone before the sky turns mild
Sleep tonight, sleep tonight
Carry me through the cabin lights
If I dream, let the whole world start
With a window seat and a racing heart

[Verse 2]
Travel mug beside the door
Keys are waiting on the drawer
Curtains breathe across the glass
Midnight moving much too fast

I can hear the city fade
Every plan is neatly made
Still I’m wide awake and dressed
With a paper map against my chest

[Male Spoken Rap]
Passport, wallet, ticket in my hand
Five a.m. alarm, got a sunrise plan
No more checking, no more pacing the hall
One deep breath, let the night fall
Bag by the doorway, shoes lined up straight
Dreaming of the runway, don’t wanna be late
Turn off the lamp, let the silence begin
Tomorrow’s calling from the other side of the wind

[Pre-Chorus]
Close your eyes, the room turns wide
Runway dreams are on your side
Count the minutes, let them go
Morning knows the way to show

[Chorus]
Sleep tonight, sleep tonight
Morning’s waiting for the light
Hold me close, don’t let time run wild
I’ll be gone before the sky turns mild
Sleep tonight, sleep tonight
Carry me through the cabin lights
If I dream, let the whole world start
With a window seat and a racing heart

[Breakdown]
Breathe in slow
Let the suitcase wait
Breathe in slow
The door can open late
No more clocks
No more counting through
Night, stay soft
I’m almost there with you

[Final Chorus]
Sleep tonight, sleep tonight
Morning’s waiting for the light
Hold me close, don’t let time run wild
I’ll be gone before the sky turns mild
Sleep tonight, sleep tonight
Carry me through the cabin lights
If I dream, let the whole world start
With a window seat and a racing heart

[Outro]
Alarm set, suitcase closed
Eyes shut tight, the runway glows
Sleep tonight
I’m ready when the morning goes

title: No Sleep, No Sleep
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Chopped vocal sample: Sleep... sleep... go to sleep!)
One, two, three, four, five AM!
Oh no, not again!

[Verse 1 - Male spoken/rap]
Got the bags packed, sitting by the door
Passport, boarding pass, triple-checked the drawer
Flight's at seven, gotta leave here at four
But my mind's running laps on the bedroom floor
Staring at the ceiling, trying to breathe deep
Counting up the hours that I'll never get to sleep
Alarm's gonna blast in a couple of ticks
Come on, brain, just a little quick fix!

[Chorus - Female Lead, soaring vocals]
Oh, why can't I close my eyes tonight?
Just a few hours till the morning light!
The countdown is on, the clock's ticking fast
Wishing this midnight insomnia would pass!
In the sky, so high, I will fly away
But I'm wide awake, dreading the day!

[Verse 2 - Male spoken/rap]
Three AM now, temperature is rising
Tossing and turning, no compromise, and
Will I miss the gate? Will I miss the plane?
This pre-travel panic is driving me insane!
Drink some warm milk? No, it's too late
Just gotta surrender to my sleepless fate!

[Chorus - Female Lead, soaring vocals]
Oh, why can't I close my eyes tonight?
Just a few hours till the morning light!
The countdown is on, the clock's ticking fast
Wishing this midnight insomnia would pass!
In the sky, so high, I will fly away
But I'm wide awake, dreading the day!

[Outro]
(Chopped vocal sample: Sleep... sleep... flight's today!)
Beep... beep... beep...
Time to go. No sleep.
Let's fly.

title: A Little More Love
lyrics:
[Intro: piano stabs, vocal chop]

Love me, love me
Just a little more

[Verse 1]

Every city gives me someone
every room another spark
Every stranger turns familiar
when I get close enough to heart

I collect a thousand stories
little pieces of their light
Then I leave with all their voices
still inside me every night

[Pre-Chorus]

I say I have enough
then somebody smiles
and suddenly my heart
runs another thousand miles

[Chorus]

I need a little more love
a little more connection
Every heart I touch
pulls me another direction

I love you, I love them
I love the whole world too
And every time I find somebody
I need somebody new

A little more love
a little more tonight
I keep filling up my heart
but it never feels quite right

[Rap / Spoken Verse]

One face, two face, three in the crowd
Every little connection turning me loud
I give my heart away, piece by piece
Looking for the feeling that will give me peace

North side, south side, anywhere I go
Someone has a story and I need to know
Too many doors and I open them all
Catch me when I rise, love me when I fall

[Breakdown: filtered beat]

Maybe I’m greedy
Maybe I’m free
Maybe every person
shows another side of me

[Build]

One more laugh
One more touch
One more reason
to care too much

[Final Chorus]

I need a little more love
a little more connection
Every heart I touch
pulls me another direction

I love you, I love them
I love the whole world too
And every time I find somebody
I need somebody new

A little more love
a little more tonight
I keep filling up my heart
but it never feels quite right

[Outro: vocal chops]

More love
More love
Always room
for a little more love

title: A Hundred Pieces of Me
lyrics:
[Intro]
Count them out slowly—one through one hundred
Each one a promise I carried under my tongue

[Verse 1]
I split my heart on the kitchen tile
Made little parcels, labeled them by hand
Gave one to the friend who knew my childhood
One to the stranger who said they understood

I kept the smallest piece behind my teeth
For the days when everybody left
But trust is a door with a borrowed key
And some hands learn exactly where to turn it

[Pre-Chorus]
I watched the pieces cross the room
Like red cards in a dealer's grip
Every gift became a private wound
Every name became a sinking ship

[Chorus]
A hundred pieces of me
A hundred doors to break
You took the part that knew your name
And ground it into the pavement
A hundred pieces of me
I gave them out to live
Now I am counting what survived
And learning what not to give

[Verse 2]
One went to the cousin with the borrowed coat
One to the lover who slept beside the wall
One to the boss who praised my patience
Then used my silence as a hallway to walk through

There was a kid who kept my picture
Until his mother threw it out
There was a room where I was welcome
Till someone laughed and locked it down

[Pre-Chorus]
I called each fracture by its first name
Pressed my thumb against the seam
Somebody always wants the whole thing
Nobody asks what holding costs me

[Chorus]
A hundred pieces of me
A hundred hands to feed
You took the part that still believed
And taught it how to bleed
A hundred pieces of me
I gave them without a net
Now I am gathering the living ones
And naming them as mine again

[Bridge]
Do not mistake the ruins for a sentence
Do not call the wreckage all I am
I can build a heart with fewer windows
I can choose the lock, I can choose the hand

I will not curse the ones who crushed me
But I will stop supplying stone
There is a difference between being open
And leaving every door unowned

[Breakdown]
Ninety-six, ninety-seven
Three still warm beneath the dust
Ninety-eight, ninety-nine
One says stay, one says trust
One hundred—nothing left to scatter
Nothing left to prove or send
I put the pieces on the table
And begin with what remains

[Final Chorus]
A hundred pieces of me
You do not get them all
I kept the pulse beneath the damage
I kept my name beneath the fall
A hundred pieces of me
Some vanished, some were changed
But every fragment I reclaim
Turns the wound into a blade

[Outro]
Count them out slowly
Not for the ones who broke them
For the hands I choose tomorrow
For the heart I am still holding

title: A Hundred Pieces
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I took my chest and I opened it wide
A hundred neat rows sitting inside
A hundred small fractions of beating and red
"Take what you need," is the whisper I said
I handed them out to the crowd on the street
To the cold and the passing, the ones I would meet
And ninety-five kept them or put them away
But five of them threw them where heavy boots tread.

[Chorus]
A hundred pieces of a single heart
Scattered like dust when they tear it apart!
You crush the fraction that I gave to you
And the whole ninety-nine feel the fracture run through!
It's a beautiful mess, it's a terrible trade
To bleed for the people who walk on the blade!
A hundred pieces, and some are just stone
But the ones that are broken leave me half-alone.

[Verse 2]
I feel the sharp sting of a far-away heel
Grinding a corner of glass that was real
A sudden cold spasm, a shudder at night
Somebody's throwing their fragment from flight
I can't ask for return of the ones that they keep
So I lie in the silence and count them to sleep
The ninety-five holding, the five in the clay
My divided chest beats in a strange, broken way.

[Bridge]
No math can repair this
No formula heals
The arithmetic pain of the way a heart feels
Divide it by hundred, subtract three or four
The remainder is bleeding all over the floor.

[Outro]
I still have the pieces...
The ones they didn't break...
But oh, the quiet ache...
Of the ones they did.

title: Tell Me I Was Here
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I count the rooms I never stayed in
Names I carried, names I traded
Every photograph keeps fading
Before the chemicals can save it

I built a ladder out of hours
Climbed until my hands were flowers
At the top, the view was vacant
Just a question wearing my face

[Pre-Chorus]
When the last light leaves the window
When the dust gets every name
Will the shape I made from living
Look like anything but waste?

[Chorus]
Tell me I was here
Tell me I was more than passing through
If the world forgets my footsteps
Let my hands still reach for you

Tell me I was here
Even if the answer disappears
I don't need forever waiting
I just need one honest year

[Verse 2]
I kept receipts for every sacrifice
Pinned them underneath the kitchen light
Called it proof that I was moving
But the paper never answered back

My father’s watch is in the drawer now
Still it ticks like it knows how
All the minutes I abandoned
All the doors I never walked through

[Pre-Chorus]
When the last voice leaves the hallway
When the mirror loses shape
Will the love I gave in fragments
Be enough to leave a trace?

[Chorus]
Tell me I was here
Tell me I was more than passing through
If the world forgets my footsteps
Let my hands still reach for you

Tell me I was here
Even if the answer disappears
I don't need forever waiting
I just need one honest year

[Bridge]
Maybe meaning isn't marble
Maybe it is bread passed round
A coat left on somebody's shoulders
A chair pulled out, a safe way home

Maybe every small forgiveness
Outlives monuments and gold
Maybe I am not a headline
Maybe I am what I hold

[Breakdown]
I was here
I was here
Not a saint, not a warning
Not a number in the morning

I was here
I was here
With my mouth full of questions
With my hands still reaching

[Final Chorus]
Tell me I was here
No, I know I was here because I changed
Every life that touched my living
Every bruise I helped to name

Tell me I was here
Let the silence take the rest
I will leave this world unfinished
With a pulse inside my chest

[Outro]
If the end erases records
If the dark outlasts the flame
I was here beside you breathing
And that was not nothing
That was not nothing
That was not nothing

title: Wings Against the Wall
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I leave my body by the bedroom lamp
Fold up the worry, let it lose its shape
The ceiling opens like a paper map
And every road is calling out my name

I walk through rooms I never built awake
A kitchen full of rain, a hallway made of clay
The hands I lost come reaching through the haze
They don't ask questions, they just make me stay

[Pre-Chorus]
If the dark can hold me
Let it hold me whole
I have carried every fracture
Like a second soul

[Chorus]
Tonight I can become
A river, a bell, a door undone
The wounds that kept me small
Turn into wings against the wall
I fall, I fall, I fall asleep
And find the parts I couldn't keep
When morning calls my name
I'll rise with nothing left to blame

[Verse 2]
A red moon rolls across a field of glass
I see my younger face and let it pass
The things I feared are wearing borrowed masks
They bow once, then dissolve into the grass

A train made out of thunder leaves the station
I climb aboard with no destination
Each window shows a different constellation
Each one says: begin without permission

[Pre-Chorus]
Let the impossible
Open up its hands
I was never meant to heal here
Where I understand

[Chorus]
Tonight I can become
A river, a bell, a door undone
The wounds that kept me small
Turn into wings against the wall
I fall, I fall, I fall asleep
And find the parts I couldn't keep
When morning calls my name
I'll rise with nothing left to blame

[Bridge]
Choir in the distance, silver in the floor
I meet the self I buried at the door
She says, You don't have to win this night
I say, I know
And step into the light

[Breakdown]
No map
No crown
No need to make it make sense now
No debt
No proof
The heart can mend in stranger rooms

[Final Chorus]
Tonight I can become
A river, a bell, a door undone
The wounds that kept me small
Turn into wings against the wall
I fall, I fall, I fall asleep
And find the parts I couldn't keep
When morning calls my name
I'll rise with nothing left to blame

[Outro]
The room returns, the window turns pale
My breath is a boat, my body a sail
I wake with the impossible under my skin
Not healed forever—just ready again

title: The Room Has a Key
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When I close the door, the ceiling turns wide
A red paper moon rolls under the tide
I meet every version I buried awake
They hand me the pieces I thought I should break

[Pre-Chorus]
No judge in the hallway
No lock on the chest
The impossible calls me
And gives me a rest

[Chorus]
Let me fall through the floor
Let the lost doors swing
I can wake with a wound
That remembers to sing
If the dark is a room
Then the room has a key
Every dream makes a country
That carries me

[Verse 2]
I ride on a staircase that grows as I climb
Past rooms full of birthdays I left behind
A child with my eyes draws a map on my sleeve
Says, take what you need, you don't have to believe

[Pre-Chorus]
The river runs backward
The old names dissolve
My hands stop defending
What sleep can resolve

[Chorus]
Let me fall through the floor
Let the lost doors swing
I can wake with a wound
That remembers to sing
If the dark is a room
Then the room has a key
Every dream makes a country
That carries me

[Bridge]
I was not broken, only braced
I was not empty, only faced
With every fear I couldn't name
Until the night rebuilt my frame

[Breakdown]
Open the gate
Undo the chain
Give me the storm
Give me the rain
I come back changed
I come back clear
The life I was hiding
Is waiting here

[Final Chorus]
Let me fall through the floor
Let the lost doors swing
I can wake with a wound
That remembers to sing
If the dark is a room
Then the room has a key
Every dream makes a country
That carries me

[Outro]
When morning arrives, I keep what it gave
A door in my breathing, a heart I can save

title: Keep the Window Cracked
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I fell asleep with the window cracked
And a paper moon on the bedroom wall
Somewhere beneath the mattress springs
A second country heard my call

I walked through fields of silver wheat
Where every stalk knew my old name
A river carried the words I lost
And brought them back without the blame

[Pre-Chorus]
There were doors in the clouds
There were stairs in the sea
Every impossible place
Made room for me

[Chorus]
Let the strange world open
Let it pull me through
I can set down the burden
I kept mistaking for truth
When the dark turns generous
And the sleeping heart knows
I come back with a wider chest
And a road where the hurt used to close

[Verse 2]
I met a child with my tired eyes
She held a match beneath the rain
She said, You don't have to earn the dawn
You don't have to explain your pain

We built a house from borrowed doors
Hung blue bells along the stairs
The roof was made of breathing birds
And nothing broke when I left my cares

[Pre-Chorus]
There were hands in the walls
There was warmth in the stone
Every impossible place
Taught me I'm home

[Chorus]
Let the strange world open
Let it pull me through
I can set down the burden
I kept mistaking for truth
When the dark turns generous
And the sleeping heart knows
I come back with a wider chest
And a road where the hurt used to close

[Bridge]
If I vanish, let me wander
Past the maps I used to guard
Let the dream undo the armor
Let the soft become the hard

I have carried every question
Like a suitcase full of rain
Now the sky unzips above me
And I breathe without the chain

[Final Chorus]
Let the strange world open
Let it pull me through
I can set down the burden
And return as something new
When the dark turns generous
And the sleeping heart knows
I come back with a wider chest
With a living fire under the bones

[Outro]
Keep the window cracked
Keep the paper moon
If I sleep, I’m not disappearing
I’m making room

title: Release the Verdict
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I drew a courtroom in my head
And took the witness stand
I listed every crooked step
Like proof I couldn't change

I wore the names I gave myself
Like medals made of tin
Then found the door was never locked
And mercy let me in

[Pre-Chorus]
For the hand that slipped
For the word that cut
For the road I chose
When I didn't know enough

[Chorus]
I release the verdict
I release the blame
The angel and the monster
Both of them have my name
I will make mistakes tomorrow
I will make them today
And I can love this broken creature
While it learns another way

[Verse 2]
Some mornings I am gentle
Some nights I turn to stone
I build a house from promises
Then leave the lights alone

I have been the storm and shelter
The wound and waiting bandage
A pair of wings with muddy feet
Still rising from the damage

[Pre-Chorus]
For the doors I closed
For the trust I bent
For the years I spent
Trying to be innocent

[Chorus]
I release the verdict
I release the blame
The angel and the monster
Both of them have my name
I will make mistakes tomorrow
I will make them today
And I can love this broken creature
While it learns another way

[Bridge]
Come here, you frightened thing
Put down the stone
You don't have to earn
The right to come home

The halo can be crooked
The claws can unclench
A heart can hold the damage
And still become a bridge

[Final Chorus]
I release the verdict
I release the blame
The angel and the monster
Both of them have my name
I will make mistakes tomorrow
I will make them today
And I can love this broken creature
While it learns another way

[Outro]
No more courtroom in my head
No more sentence carved in shame
The angel and the monster
I will answer to my name

title: Scattered Heart
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I left a little in Lisbon rain
A thread in a stranger’s borrowed name
A piece on a train through northern towns
A pulse where the harbor lights went down

I gave you the part that knew how to stay
Gave her the nerve to walk away
Gave them a laugh for the long flight home
Now every map has a piece of my own

[Pre-Chorus]
I kept saying I’d gather it back
When the roads stopped pulling me off track
But the farther I went, the more I knew
Each open door was a piece cut loose

[Chorus]
My heart is scattered everywhere
In your coat pocket, her kitchen chair
In a voice that calls from a different shore
In the hands of the ones I can’t reach anymore
I gave it away, and I’m still alive
A thousand small sparks, a thousand drives
It won’t all come home, and that’s the truth
I am made of the places I gave to you

[Verse 2]
There’s a scar in a café near Rome
A blue wristband from a night in Seoul
A postcard folded beneath my bed
With something kind I was too scared to say

I used to call that loss by another name
Count every goodbye like a personal blame
Now I see the pieces don’t make me less
They prove I was there, I said yes

[Pre-Chorus]
I kept wanting one room, one name
One clean border around the flame
But love doesn’t fit in a single frame
It leaves through the window and signs its name

[Chorus]
My heart is scattered everywhere
In your coat pocket, her kitchen chair
In a voice that calls from a different shore
In the hands of the ones I can’t reach anymore
I gave it away, and I’m still alive
A thousand small sparks, a thousand drives
It won’t all come home, and that’s the truth
I am made of the places I gave to you

[Bridge]
If you carry a piece, don’t carry the debt
You don’t have to promise you won’t forget
Let it beat where your life has begun
I was never built to belong to one

[Final Chorus]
My heart is scattered everywhere
In your coat pocket, her kitchen chair
In the morning trains and the salt-thick air
In every person who found me there
I gave it away, and I’m still alive
Not whole in one place, but wider inside
It won’t all come home, and I’m finally free
Every piece I gave became part of me

[Outro]
Somewhere you’re holding what I couldn’t keep
Somewhere I’m learning the distance can breathe

title: My Heart Is Everywhere Now
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I left a piece in Lisbon rain
A little heat in a stranger's name
Sent one north where the long trains run
Kept one warm for my sister's son

I gave one away in a market crowd
One to a friend who said it out loud
Every goodbye took a different shape
Every new door made another break

[Pre-Chorus]
I kept trying to gather the scattered parts
With both hands pressed against my heart
But the map kept growing under my skin
And there was no way to fold it in

[Chorus]
My heart is everywhere now
A room in a hundred towns
A hand on a shoulder, a light left on
A name I carry when the person is gone
My heart is everywhere now
It won't come back in one piece somehow
I used to call that losing ground
Now I know love is how it gets around

[Verse 2]
There is a window facing the sea
That holds a version of what I could be
A kitchen where somebody saves my seat
A dusty road with my song underneath

I mailed my courage across the blue
Left my patience with someone new
I thought a heart was a house with a door
Now mine has hallways I can't count anymore

[Pre-Chorus]
I kept trying to name what remained
The missing, the mercy, the mark, the stain
But every fragment learned to beat
In places I may never see

[Chorus]
My heart is everywhere now
A room in a hundred towns
A hand on a shoulder, a light left on
A name I carry when the person is gone
My heart is everywhere now
It won't come back in one piece somehow
I used to call that losing ground
Now I know love is how it gets around

[Bridge]
So if I seem distant, I am not gone
I am in the bread, I am in the dawn

Let every country keep what it found
Let every small piece keep making sound

[Final Chorus]
My heart is everywhere now
A room in a hundred towns
A hand on a shoulder, a light left on
A name I carry when the person is gone
My heart is everywhere now
It won't come back in one piece somehow
I used to call that losing ground
Now I know love is how it gets around

[Outro]
Keep a piece, keep a piece
Wherever you are
Keep a piece, keep a piece
That is where my heart starts

title: Small Pieces, Wide World
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I left a thread in Manila rain
A coin in a cab in Madrid
A promise folded in Lisbon blue
A name I forgot but the feeling stayed hid

I gave you the part that knew how to wait
You took the part that could forgive
Now every border has one of my hands

[Pre-Chorus]
I keep a room inside my ribs

[Chorus]
I gave my heart in little pieces

A piece underneath someone else’s home
I gave my heart in little pieces
Now it will never beat in one place again
But I’m not broken, I’m spread out
I’m more than the person I was back then

[Verse 2]
There’s a blue scarf under Tokyo seats
A photograph near the Nile

[Pre-Chorus]
I keep a map inside my chest

[Chorus]
I gave my heart in little pieces
To strangers I still call my own
A piece in the heat, a piece in the harbor
A piece underneath someone else’s home
I gave my heart in little pieces
Now it will never beat in one place again
But I’m not broken, I’m spread out

If you find me in the voice of a friend

[Final Chorus]
I gave my heart in little pieces
To strangers I still call my own
A piece in the heat, a piece in the harbor
A piece underneath someone else’s home
I gave my heart in little pieces
It will never beat in one place again
I’m not missing, I’m spread out

[Outro]
Small pieces, wide world
Still mine, still moving
Small pieces, wide world
I’m not lost—I’m becoming

title: Scattered Map
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I left a thread in Manila rain
A little red in a stranger's name
Sent one flame to a kitchen in Rome
Now every welcome feels like home

I gave my laugh to a late-night train
My better words to a windowpane
A piece of trust at a border line
A piece of sleep in a borrowed time

[Pre-Chorus]
I keep counting the rooms I've crossed

[Chorus]
My heart is scattered, and that's alright

My heart won't gather in one place again

I am not less for the pieces gone

[Verse 2]
There is a postcard under my bed
With a blue stamp and the things unsaid
A borrowed coat in a northern town
A song someone hums when the sun goes down

I left my patience beside the sea
My old fear in a market alley
Gave my name to a doorway light

[Pre-Chorus]
I keep counting the miles I've crossed

[Chorus]
My heart is scattered, and that's alright
One part in daylight, one part in night

Now I wear every fracture like a map

My heart won't gather in one place again
It's in the hands of a hundred friends
I am not less for the pieces gone

[Bridge]
Let it stay where the kindness grew

[Final Chorus]
My heart is scattered, and that's alright

Now I wear every fracture like a map

title: Cracks Are Part of Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I count the flaws beneath my shirt

I practice smiles in bathroom glass

I call it drive, I call it grit

[Pre-Chorus]
I keep treating my own heart

Every bruise becomes a mark
Every mirror holds me back

[Chorus]
I am not a problem to solve
Not a race I have to win
I can meet myself where I am
And still become who I am within
All these cracks are part of me
All this fear can lose its teeth
I am not less because I bend
I am myself, and I begin again

[Verse 2]
I borrow faces from the crowd
Wear their standards like they are proud
I trade my sleep for one more proof
Then wonder why I hate the truth

The voice that says I am behind

[Pre-Chorus]
I keep turning every scar

[Chorus]
I am not a problem to solve
Not a race I have to win
I can meet myself where I am
And still become who I am within
All these cracks are part of me
All this fear can lose its teeth
I am not less because I bend
I am myself, and I begin again

[Final Chorus]
I am not a problem to solve
Not a race I have to win
I can meet myself where I am
And still become who I am within
All these cracks are part of me
All this fear can lose its teeth
I am not less because I bend
I am myself, and I begin again
I am myself, and I begin again

[Outro]
I am here
I am here
